question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: The choice changes model-visible context, session state, plugin/channel contracts, retry expectations, and redaction policy, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Shared Typed Contract
options.body: Define a single sanitized delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

options.title: Status Only
options.body: Expose structured delivery status through agent/tool result surfaces without injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep Narrow Paths
options.body: Leave current CLI, Gateway, cron, and channel-specific handling as supported behavior and close this broader request later as not planned.

recommendation.title: Shared Typed Contract
recommendation.body: Define a single sanitized delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail for durable outbound delivery and message delivery API ownership points to steipete's commits.
